stock.description: Wise Ally International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides electronics manufacturing services with a focus on consumer electronic products. The company provides design engineering; validation and verification comprising design validation, clean room validation, assembly process validation, part molding validation, packaging validation, and sterilization validation; risk management, including risk planning, assessment, mitigation, and control; and support services for medical and healthcare products. It engages in the design, development, and production of printed circuit board assemblies, multifunctional modules, and finished electronic products; provision of support design and engineering, manufacturing, quality control and testing, and project management services for heating, ventilation, and air-conditionings; and turnkey solutions for consumer electronics, as well as solutions for commercial and industrial controls, vapour products, and appliances. In addition, the company provides Internet of Things solutions, such as sustainability/energy management, asset management, and workplace environment quality. Further, it trades in electronic products. The company operates in Hong Kong, the United States, the Philippines, Ireland, Switzerland, Mainland China, Malaysia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, and internationally. Wise Ally International Holdings Limited was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong. Wise Ally International Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Smartview Investments Limited.
